definitions.explanation: A school that admits only female students. Can refer to any level from elementary through university, though most commonly refers to middle schools and high schools.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女子校|じょしこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My older sister attends a girls' school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{女子校|じょしこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a well-known girls' school in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{女子校|じょしこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{共学|きょうがく}→共学：15412_kyougaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the declining birthrate, more and more girls' schools are becoming coeducational.

notes:
An abbreviated form of {女子学校|じょしがっこう}. Composed of ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ (girl, female) and {校|こう} (school).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女子校|じょしこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend a girls' school
- {女子校|じょしこう}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: from a girls' school
- ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧{女子校|じょしこう}: private girls' school
- ⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧{女子校|じょしこう}: prestigious girls' school

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{男子校|だんしこう}→男子校：15311_danshikou⟧: boys' school — the male counterpart
- ⟦{共学|きょうがく}→共学：15412_kyougaku⟧: coeducation / coeducational school — a school that admits both genders
- {女子大|じょしだい}: women's university — the university equivalent

USAGE:
In Japan, single-sex schools remain relatively common, especially among private and traditional schools. However, many have transitioned to coeducation ({共学化|きょうがくか}) in recent decades.
